frontmatter.sidebar_description: Refresh a cart's shipping methods after an update.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `refreshCartShippingMethodsWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow refreshes a cart's shipping methods, ensuring that their associated shipping options can still be used on the cart,
and retrieve their correct pricing after a cart update. This workflow is used by the [refreshCartItemsWorkflow](/references/medusa-workflows/refreshCartItemsWorkflow).

You can use this workflow within your own customizations or custom workflows, allowing you to refresh the cart's shipping method after making updates to the cart.

If you use this workflow in another, you must acquire a lock before running it and release the lock after. Learn more in the [Locking Operations in Workflows](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/workflows/locks#locks-in-nested-workflows) guide.

steps.name: validateCartStep
steps.description:
This step validates a cart to ensure it exists and is not completed.
If not valid, the step throws an error.

:::tip

You can use the [retrieveCartStep](/references/medusa-workflows/steps/retrieveCartStep) to retrieve a cart's details.

:::
